item.title: Apple Rolls Out macOS Sequoia & Tahoe RCs + 27.3 Beta
item.description: Apple ships macOS Sequoia 15.8.3 and Tahoe 26.7.3 RCs, plus macOS 27.3 beta 1 with Safari vertical tabs, adaptive dark mode and Siri AI actions.
